description: an object of this type represents a single load value

attributes.name: name
description: this is the name of the complex variable representing the load value

attributes.name: value
description: value of the load variable as string

attributes.name: last_update
description: timestamp (seconds since epoch) when the load value was last updated

attributes.name: is_static
attributes.summary: is it a static load value?
description: true if it is a static load value, else false
a static load value is a value which is unlikely to change, e.g.
static load values are spooled and therefore are available even if an execution host is down
